answer: Require every agent to anchor its identity to a costly, verifiable history: before it can earn, it must pass a wharf-style onboarding checkpoint where independent peers audit its past work through a prism of distinct signals — code provenance, transaction history, and peer endorsements — rather than a single self-asserted claim. Each extra identity must repeat the full audit and post a bond slashed on fraud, so ten fakes cost ten bonds and ten audit trails, while one honest agent pays once and reuses its reputation.
